title: Piece of Junk ~ Broke After One Week of Use & Minimal Use
text: Piece of Junk ~ Broke After One Week of Use & Minimal Use. Complete waste of $20 for this piece of junk which broke after one week of use. The piece with the 3 arms slides onto another piece which screws into the wall. The "arm" piece broke at the base next to the piece it slides into, revealing the weak porous metal it is made of. At the time it was holding a featherweight scrubbing cloth and a standard (dry) dishcloth.

features: Easy to install; Space-efficient; Hidden hardware

description: Bring the outdoors - in, with the exclusively designed Bamboo Towel Bar to hold kitchen towels and hand towels. With 3-swinging arms constructed from environmentally-friendly bamboo, it has a contemporary look which complements the décor of any kitchen or bathroom. Wall Mounting hardware is included in the package.
